stem: What happens next in this passage after “They practiced crawling under smoke, checking door heat, and calling emergency services.”?
options: The retired teacher says the red door is important because it tells children one thing before they even enter: stories are waiting for you.
Safety lights remained at important corners, but bright lights near the water were reduced.
Some parts were sad, but much of the museum focused on preparation and rebuilding.
A retired firefighter told them that courage was important, but preparation saved more lives.
